items.title: Govt debunks PM Modi's video promising school children will receive free recharge on their mobiles
items.snippet_en: The government debunked a video purportedly showing Prime Minister Narendra Modi promising free recharges for school-going children, stating that the claim is fake and the video was created by artificial intelligence (AI).

items.title: Fact Check: Viral posts claim BJP, PM Modi are offering free recharge after Lok Sabha election results, here's the truth
items.snippet_en: The PIB debunked similar posts claiming PM Modi's free recharge schemes, clarifying that neither the government nor PM Modi is running any such scheme. The article warns against clicking on unknown links.

items.title: Is PM Narendra Modi Offering 3 Months of Mobile Recharge for Free? Fact Check Calls Claim Fake
items.snippet_en: PIB Fact Check debunked a viral message claiming PM Narendra Modi is offering three months of free mobile recharge to all Indian users, confirming that no such scheme exists. The government warned citizens against fraudulent links.

items.title: Govt debunks fake video claiming PM Modi announced free three-month recharge
items.snippet_en: The government debunked a social media video claiming Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a free three-month recharge for all citizens, stating the claim is fake and the video is AI-generated. The PIB Fact Check Unit clarified no such scheme has been endorsed.

items.title: तीन महीने वाला रिचार्ज फ्री दे रहे मोदी, लिंक पर क्लिक कीजिए... क्या आपके पास आ रहा है ऐसा मैसेज? पढ़ें इसका सच - Cyber Crime cyber thugs modi give three month free recharge
items.snippet_en: This article reports on cybercriminals sharing links on social media, particularly WhatsApp, claiming that PM Narendra Modi is giving a free three-month recharge worth 599 rupees to all mobile users. It highlights that many people have been duped by such messages.

items.title: पीएम मोदी दे रहे हैं 3 महीने का मुफ्त रिचार्ज? जानिए सच क्या है
items.snippet_en: PIB Fact Check clarified that neither the Prime Minister nor the central government is running any such scheme, and there has been no official announcement or confirmation from telecom companies. The claim is described as misleading and fake.

items.title: Fact Check: Viral posts claim BJP, PM Modi are offering free recharge after Lok Sabha election results, here's the truth
items.snippet_en: This article debunks claims of free recharge schemes by PM Modi, stating that such posts are fake and often contain links to dubious websites. It implies that any urgency or limited-time offer associated with such schemes is a tactic to defraud users.

items.title: Is PM Narendra Modi Offering 3 Months of Mobile Recharge for Free? Fact Check Calls Claim Fake
items.snippet_en: This article debunks the claim of PM Modi offering free mobile recharge, stating that the message is a fraudulent attempt to mislead and cheat people. The mention of a limited-time offer is a common characteristic of such scams.

items.title: तीन महीने वाला रिचार्ज फ्री दे रहे मोदी, लिंक पर क्लिक कीजिए... क्या आपके पास आ रहा है ऐसा मैसेज? पढ़ें इसका सच - Cyber Crime cyber thugs modi give three month free recharge
items.snippet_en: This article discusses how cybercriminals use messages claiming free recharge offers from PM Modi to trick people into clicking malicious links. The urgency implied by "today only" or similar phrases is a common tactic in these scams to pressure users.

items.title: PM Modi 3-Month Free Recharge: Real or Fake? || Sambad
items.snippet_en: This video warns about a viral video claiming PM Modi is offering a free 3-month mobile recharge, identifying it as a dangerous trap. Such scams often create a sense of urgency to entice users to act quickly without verifying the information.

items.title: पीएम मोदी दे रहे हैं 3 महीने का मुफ्त रिचार्ज? जानिए सच क्या है
items.snippet_en: This article clarifies that claims of PM Modi offering free mobile recharge are misleading and fake, with no official announcement or confirmation. The implication is that any claim of a limited-time offer is part of the fraudulent nature of these messages.

outputs.notes_en: The claims about PM Modi offering free mobile recharge are widely debunked as fake news and scams. Multiple sources, including government fact-checking units (PIB), confirm that no such scheme exists. The claims are often used by cybercriminals to trick users into clicking malicious links, and the mention of a limited-time offer is a common tactic in these scams to create urgency.
